Description

At Serko, we believe something incredible happens when people come face-to-face. That’s why we’re on a mission to engineer a frictionless, next-generation business travel marketplace. We don’t just manage travel; we are leveraging advanced AI and cutting-edge tech to eliminate the complexity of global movement.

When you join Serko, you join a global collective of passionate technologists who show up as their true selves to build world-class products. With established hubs across New Zealand, Australia, North America, India and China - your code and ideas will impact millions of corporate travelers worldwide.

If you're ready to challenge the status quo and build the future of travel tech, your next journey starts here.

Together you'll help build the application experience layer — the web applications, and the BFF and orchestration services behind them that connect our experiences to platform services. You'll deliver well-scoped work to production with support, and learn how we build accessible, high-quality customer experiences.

You'll also learn to work agentically from day one, building the judgement to understand and check what you and your agents ship.

Requirements
Who will thrive
Curious, eager learners who want to grow fast with strong mentorship and team support.
Collaborative builders who care about crafting accessible, high-quality customer experiences.
AI-forward thinkers excited to work agentically from day one while maintaining high engineering standards.
What you'll do
Build the experience layer: Contribute to our web applications, Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) layers, and orchestration services that connect our products to core platform services.
Ship to production: Deliver well-scoped features with team support while learning our standards for accessibility and craft.
Work agentically: Use AI agents in your daily workflow, developing the judgment to thoroughly review, validate, and own everything you and your agents ship.
What you'll bring
Foundational experience in web development and backend services (through internships, projects, or early-career roles).
A strong desire to learn modern engineering, accessibility, and production best practices.
Curiosity about AI-assisted development, paired with attention to detail and a willingness to check your work carefully.
Benefits

At Serko, we aim to create a place where people can come and do their best work.  This means you’ll be operating in an environment with great tools and support to enable you to perform at the highest level of your abilities, producing high-quality and delivering innovative and efficient results. Our people are fully engaged, continuously improving, and encouraged to make an impact.

Some of the benefits of working at Serko are:

A competitive base salary
Short Term Incentive Scheme
Focus on development: Access to a learning & development platform, committed budget and opportunity for you to own your career pathways.
The pay range is between $90,000 - $110,000 USD as a base salary offering annually.

Serko is an award-winning business travel and expense software company that’s winning on a global scale. We’re already the established leader in Australasia and revolutionizing the way people do business travel in the USA and Europe – and we’re growing!

While the world of business travel is changing, we’re preparing companies for this with intelligent technology that helps them ensure the continued safety and well-being of their travelers – allowing for complex approvals where needed, giving real-time information about precautions taken by transport and accommodation suppliers, tracking and managing travel around the globe, increasing the flexibility of bookings, giving true visibility and control over costs – and we’re not stopping there. We’re backed by the biggest travel brands in the world like Booking.com and there is an exciting road ahead of us at a time where travel needs real, impactful change.

Serko is at the forefront of travel innovation and is one of the most exciting businesses to work for in the high tech sector. We now have upwards of 230 employees in 4 countries so we're still small enough for everyone to know everyone but we're big enough to take on the big boys and win. And that's the plan.

We're a diverse, close knit group with a flat structure where everyone's opinion matters and anyone can lead. We value people who have personal integrity, are adaptable, and are courageous with what they do. Serko’s people work collaboratively with energy and enthusiasm – so you’ll want to be up for the ride.

All our offices are well equipped, funky and modern and, as you'd expect, equipped with games, exceptional coffee, fresh fruit and snacks. Our environment is upbeat, energetic and fun – and we look for people to add to our culture, not just fit our culture. The work here is challenging, complex and hugely rewarding. We know how to work hard and play hard, with a really lively social scene... and we reward our people well too.

To find out more about working at Serko go to http://www.serko.com/about-serko/
